A Retention row: 30 days or Zero retention; disabled with the reason on inbound and batch; written into the snippet on code — .a step 3, .d, requirement 46, learning 3

Go live in the header on a draft agent (lands on the tab); Go live in the type row's empty state; the sheet titled Go live; New run as the batch Go live; the snippet's copy as the code Go live — .a step 4, vocabulary, learning 1
Tab named Deployment for every agent; the type name on the row; P0.1.c's ask in place for an untyped agent — .a step 1, .f, requirement 6
